capabilities: Record positions with entry, exit, stop, target, and derived risk, P&L, and R:R
Link positions to accounts, symbols, key levels, news, confluences, and playbooks
Compute playbook win rate and net P&L from positions that used them
OCR MetaTrader and TradingView screenshots into reviewable evidence
Render candlestick charts with entry and exit markers
extras: Journal access is gated behind a LucrTrade account and plan (upgrade screen shown if the plan lacks it); charts pull live data from Yahoo and crypto exchanges; an AI-agent skill and agent API are provided for automated journaling; documentation lives on an external site.
motivation: The README's 'Why keep the journal in Obsidian' section says records should stay in the vault with no cloud or lock-in, and trades should link to their context for review.
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to log trades and connect each position to the key levels, news, analysis, and playbook behind it.

relations.evidence: crypto from your account's exchange (Binance, Bybit, OKX)
local OCR recognizes MetaTrader and TradingView screenshots
AI coding agents that can run shell commands (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …)

requires.name: AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) for agent API use

summary: Trading journal that records positions, accounts, symbols, and playbooks as linked Markdown files in the vault, with OCR, charts, and playbook statistics.
